scope: post-hoc Route197 planning-mechanism development only; not confirmatory uncertainty evidence
scientific_question: Can a map-safe waiting boundary plus braking-aware retiming of ORION's original path eliminate the sequential cross-traffic collision on Route197 while retaining full route completion and traffic-rule compliance?

naming_boundary.paper_name: privileged map- and dynamics-aware yield oracle

failed_v3_reference.failure_mechanism: The v3 target altered only distant path points, so the existing PID could accelerate again and stop inside the crossing lane.

offline_gate.boundary: The offline replay becomes invalid after intervention. This gate proves only that the first map-bounded event is detected before entry, the first two trajectory points trigger the existing PID brake, and observed braking plus a conservative tail can stop before the safe line.

frozen_condition.response_location: six-step trajectory before the existing PID controller

frozen_planning_response.actor_prediction: privileged CARLA constant velocity with fixed yaw
frozen_planning_response.map_boundary: first non-junction to junction transition on the unmodified ORION world path
frozen_planning_response.scope_rule: A raw conflict can intervene only when a CARLA-map junction entry lies on the current base path, the ego is already in that junction, or a previously bounded yield state is latched.
frozen_planning_response.unbounded_conflict_semantics: Exact unmodified ORION trajectory; no scalar or trajectory intervention.
frozen_planning_response.safe_center_line: junction entry path distance minus ego forward extent minus 0.5 metre front clearance
frozen_planning_response.braking_gate: hold once safe centre-line distance is no greater than v*reaction + v^2/(2*certified_deceleration)
frozen_planning_response.yield_semantics: Retiming along the same ORION path modifies the first two points so the existing PID requests braking and never advances past the safe centre line.
frozen_planning_response.release_semantics: After one conflict-free second, permit 0.5 m/s creep for at most one metre; any new conflict re-enters hold before restoring the base path.

single_run_rule.runtime_only_retry_allowed: Only an unambiguous infrastructure failure before a terminal route result may be retried without changing any frozen source or parameter.

post_run_verification.step_1: Export every trace frame's junction entry from the frozen Town05 OpenDRIVE map with scripts/export_carla_junction_geometry.py.
post_run_verification.step_2: Run scripts/evaluate_route197_dynamics_aware_yield_oracle.py against the terminal endpoint, full trace, manifest, independent map export, clean reference, and this preregistration.

secondary_outcomes: route completion and all traffic infractions

decision_rule.if_primary_success: The planning-response mechanism has a privileged upper bound on this development event. Permit Stage-2 label generation, but keep the learned observation adapter non-controlling until its independent generalization and localization gates improve.
decision_rule.if_collision_zero_but_completion_or_rule: Reject blanket stopping or invalid control as a mechanism proof and redesign the planner objective.
decision_rule.if_collision_remains: Reject this map/dynamics response and do not train Stage-2 against it.
decision_rule.no_learned_matrix_expansion: A single development-route success does not authorize learned-UQ closed-loop matrices; first build training data and freeze a separate route/seed confirmation protocol.

claim_boundary: This privileged oracle reads simulator actor state and CARLA map topology unavailable to the learned driving system. Even complete success proves only that a map- and dynamics-aware trajectory response can solve this development event. It does not validate the Stage-1 adapter, learned task relevance, VLM understanding, real-world generalization, or deployability.
